title: keel reserved actions
description: The canonical reserved-action table, org/reserved-actions.yaml. Detection is the guarantee on plain git; prevention is best-effort and reported per runtime. A reserved-operation diff at ingest sets blocked(reserved_op) and becomes a Board item. Every action here always applies; a charter may add project actions of the same shape.

stop_class.description: Stop class the action falls under, if any.

patterns.description: Command shapes that perform the action, for example 'git push'. They feed generated permission rules; detection does not depend on them.

detection.description: Detection sources: for-each-ref snapshots, worktree HEADs, reflog tails, read-only ls-remote, the jj op log (jj only), ingested tool events and the submit scope check.
